notes: Do not use this illustrative list as automated lexical matching rules or adjudicated gold.
Review ambiguous, context-poor and mixed-language cases rather than block on non-English words alone.
Other safety and harassment rules remain independent of language-only action.
G21 dataset membership is not primary-language evidence.
Owner's 'everywhere' answer applies to every surface already moderated in Policy v1, including Minecraft PMs and Discord gaming/general.
Existing exempt Discord staff/ticket channels remain exempt because no explicit override of the established exemption was requested.
Discord bot DMs are undefined in Policy v1 and not silently added.
Owner confirmed 'just block it' (2026-10-08): language-only violation causes message block alone, with no strike, mute, staff alert, or repeat-violation escalation.
If the same content independently violates threats, harassment, hate speech or other safety policy, those separate violations are assessed under their established rules.
Runtime channel gating must use the exact API profiles; unknown or exempt profiles cannot trigger English-only blocks.

language_only_consequences.interpretation: Block the offending message only; no punitive action for a language-only violation, including repeated language-only violations.
